# bridge that carried `goods:pottery` as a scope is gone -- and with it the one
# thing between the press and the plan that could quietly not arrive.
bag_wtp_pick_skip_42 = {
	scope = country

	is_shown = {
		always = yes
	}

	effect = {
		bag_wtp_edit_skip_42 = yes
		bag_wtp_recompute_live = yes
	}
}
